question: Select the figure that will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following figure series. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/89643d5a259ca2259cb7bd5976549ef3c0331d33d1dbe3f7dc9ab067cfd1f236.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbols move as shown below and R changes into B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/020767c5aa97cbe5ba59c438c89a0fc05d68f64e4f8b848889f83a840498b7d7.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d625ca01d71fce59b8aef40d193b658c450844f4d9ae3c2134cea656a5a3fe3.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The symbols move as shown below and B changes into C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b8a7ae5e4f41bcbda6b20a9f59eaaa9aee69bc9a632cf448c716b05eb7ffa6cf.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):**

The symbols move as shown below and V changes into a triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21a4a469cfd0f8fa5e130d2252878167a09977da77e9e51a7372f3ccfb6d4e6d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
